scripts.dev: npm run env:dev && npm run docker:up
scripts.prod: npm run env:prod && npm run docker:up
scripts.setup: cp local.env .env && mkdir -p uploads && chmod 777 uploads
scripts.setup:dev: npm run env:dev && mkdir -p uploads && chmod 777 uploads
scripts.setup:prod: npm run env:prod && mkdir -p uploads && chmod 777 uploads
scripts.postgres:shell: docker exec -it haghighi_postgres psql -U haghighi_user -d haghighi_db
scripts.db:push: docker exec haghighi_backend npx prisma db push
scripts.db:migrate: docker exec haghighi_backend npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:dev: docker exec haghighi_backend npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:migrate:reset: docker exec haghighi_backend npx prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.db:seed: docker exec haghighi_backend npx prisma db seed
scripts.db:studio: docker exec haghighi_backend npx prisma studio
scripts.test:api: curl http://localhost:3000/api/health && curl -I http://localhost:3001/ && curl -I http://localhost:3002/
scripts.clean:all: npm run docker:down && docker rmi new-haghighi-frontend new-haghighi-admin new-haghighi-backend 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.fresh:start: npm run clean:all && npm run setup && npm run docker:build && npm run docker:up
scripts.fresh:start:dev: npm run clean:all && npm run setup:dev && npm run docker:build && npm run docker:up
scripts.fresh:start:prod: npm run clean:all && npm run setup:prod && npm run docker:build && npm run docker:up
